# Filament QR Code

> `mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code` is a Filament v5 package (Laravel 12/13, PHP 8.2+) that scans QR codes and barcodes with the camera, image upload or a keyboard-wedge Hardware Scanner, and generates QR codes (SVG/PNG) for forms, tables, infolists and downloads.

Scanned values write straight into the Livewire form state. Lookups and validation run on the server for each scan. Everything under `@internal` is outside semver. Every public class, method and config key is listed in the API map. Vocabulary: QR Scanner Field (`QrScanner`), Station Listener (`QrHardwareScannerListener`), Scan Sequence Container (`QrScanSequence`), Batch Collector Scanning (`QrCollector`, `QrCollectAction`), QR Generator.

- [API map](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/api.md): every public class, method, enum case and config key (generated)
- [Scanning](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/scanning.md): QR Scanner Field, Station Listener, Scan Sequence Container, server checks, continuous mode, runtime control
- [Batch collecting](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/collecting.md): `QrCollector` and `QrCollectAction`

- [Customizing](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/customizing.md): lookups, normalization, check stages, hooks, auditing, macros, styling, views
- [Extension points](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/extending.md): every seam in one table
- [Events](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/events.md): browser and Laravel events with their payloads
- [Reference](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/reference.md): config keys, hardware routing, translations, the `@internal` policy
- [FAQ](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/faq.md): iOS torch, secure context, offline use, guns, multiple panels

- [POS checkout](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/recipes/pos.md): POS checkout with continuous scanning

- [Work-order station](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/recipes/manufacturing.md): a work-order scanning station
- [Label generator page](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/recipes/generator-page.md): a page that generates QR labels

- [Styling](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/recipes/styling.md): styling a scanner or sequence
- [ZXing decoder](https://github.com/mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code/blob/main/docs/recipes/zxing-decoder.md): use ZXing as the camera decoder
